hero.intro: Spaces with attitude. We design interiors and furniture that unite function and calm.

studio.title: One studio, one point of contact, one standard.
studio.text: Studio von Boros is my practice for interior architecture and bespoke furniture in Berlin. I plan, draw and oversee the build myself — from the first measurement to the mounted front. The focus is the untapped potential of urban apartments: considered built-ins, honest materials, and spaces that make everyday life easier.
